annotations.text: A — Real tree. 1px drawn rails (not ASCII), elbow connectors, folder glyph. Current folder greyed + labelled; folders inside a moved item greyed and unpickable. Selected destination: inset fill + 2px left bar. Whole vault visible, scrolls. Bottom bar commits.

B — No tree at all. A path breadcrumb + one folder level at a time, same drill-in gesture as the vault browser itself. Tap a row to go deeper, chevron shows it has children, one button moves into the folder you're standing in. Simplest to build and to use one-handed; you lose the whole-tree overview.
C — Indentation only, no rails. Cheaper than A, still shows structure. Same greyed/selected treatment. Reads a little flat once nesting gets deep.
